entry.name: array.indexof
entry.digest: Search for the index of an array element
entry.description: Output the position of an array element within a longer array as an integer index (0-based). Output if the element cannot be found.

attributes.description: All matching indices will be output as a list. If there are no matches, a singlewill be output.
